text:
Predicates:
PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ::: x performs in school talent shows often.
Attends(x, school) ::: x attends the school.
Engaged(x, schoolEvents) ::: x is very engaged with school events.
InactiveMember(x) ::: x is an inactive and disinterested member of the community.
ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) ::: x chaperones high school dances.
Student(x) ::: x is a student who attends the school.
WishesFurther(x, academic) ::: x wishes to further their academic careers and opportunities.
YoungChildOrTeenager(x) ::: x is a young child or teenager.
Bonnie ::: Bonnie.
Premises:
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) → Attends(x, school) ∧ Engaged(x, schoolEvents)) ::: If people perform in school talent shows often, then they attend and are very engaged with school events.
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ∨ InactiveMember(x)) ::: People either perform in school talent shows often or are inactive and disinterested members of their community.
ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) → ¬Student(x) ::: If people chaperone high school dances, then they are not students who attend the school.
∀x (InactiveMember(x) → ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x)) ::: All inactive and disinterested members of the community chaperone high school dances.
∀x ((WishesFurther(x, academic)) ∧ (YoungChildOrTeenager(x))) → Student(x) ::: All young children and teenagers who wish to further their academic careers and opportunities are students who attend the school.
Bonnie ⇔ ( (Attends(Bonnie), Engaged(Bonnie, schoolEvents), Student(Bonnie)) ∨ (¬Attends(Bonnie), ¬Engaged(Bonnie, schoolEvents), ¬Student(Bonnie)) ) ::: Bonnie either both attends and is very engaged with school events and is a student, or neither attends nor is a student.
Conclusion:
((YoungChildOrTeenager(Bonnie)) ∧ (WishesFurther(Bonnie, academic))) ∨ (ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(Bonnie))) → (Student(Bonnie) ∨ InactiveMember(Bonnie)) ::: If Bonnie is either both a young child or teenager wishing to further her academic career and chaperones high school dances, or neither, then Bonnie is either a student who attends the school or an inactive member of the community.
